intro: The SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam held on 19 October 2026 has limited publicly available analysis. Shift 1 provides a partial review that lists English topics but lacks quantitative performance data, and its observations require further corroboration. Shifts 2 and 3 are still pending, so no usable analysis has been published for them yet. Any figures that may be cited are unofficial, and SSC normally normalises scores across shifts.
